published_title: Kyle Craft s DS Denver Grand Slam deck
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Jedi.02''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in April 2000.
description: Go to space abuse OR for a big drain.  I persoanlly think this is a deck that involves alot of play skill.  If you can play it do so if you want.
cards: Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
posted: Those rebels won't escape us x2
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Total 60 as published (no header counts). Starting cards as posted under 'Starting stuff': the Objective, Endor, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) and Endor: Bunker. The post says 'I usually star imp decree or battle order depending on deck I am against', so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted '-2', '-3', '-4' dested DS-61-2, DS-61-3, DS-61-4; 'DVDLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'U-3po' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Motti' Admiral Motti (Premiere; the Jedi Pack 'Motti' is a rare promo); 'Ozzel' Admiral Ozzel; 'Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Ephont mon' Ephant Mon; 'tarkin' Grand Moff Tarkin.

Posted 'zucass in MH', 'Boba In S1', 'bossk in bus', 'Denger in P1', 'ig-88 in 2000' dested the pilot-in-ship cards; 'vaders personal' Vader's Personal Shuttle; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Devistator' Devastator; 'Tmap 1' Tempest 1 (Endor vehicle); 'Blizz 2' Blizzard 2.

Posted 'Death ' (cut off) dested the Death Star system; 'Kassyk' Kashyyyk; 'Besbin' Bespin. 'Twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Ghhk' Ghhhk; 'Presence' Presence Of The Force; 'Omnious rumors' Ominous Rumors; 'Imp decree' Imperial Decree. Battle Order is the original Effect (not the later Defensive Shield).
Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand x2 is unique; dested as posted.
player_note: The post is titled 'Kyle Craft's DS Denver Grand Slam deck' and the strategy says 'It did just fine in the grand slam.' (posted 3 April 2000); no record or placing is given.
